purpose: The Phase 8 contract, read in batch. Same tolerances, same semantic profile and the same scope axes as phase8; the only difference is HOW the source is read, which is why it is a separate file rather than an edit to a frozen one.
why_routed: Values are worth batching: one reading of a table answers every arm in it, and three separate readings could disagree with each other for no reason except that they were three acts of reading. Arm identities are not: there is one per arm, and asking what an arm is CALLED needs a different prompt from asking what it reports. A run doing both must say so, or half its answers are attributable to a profile the artifact never names.
why_v2: Identical contract. It names evaluator 1.6.2 because D1-6.2 changed two files inside the evaluator boundary and the behaviour comparison reported 26 of 26 cases identical. phase8_batch.json names 1.6.1 and is not edited: a published contract that changes retroactively describes runs it did not govern.
